subject.title: message_tool_only: one-shot delivery reminder loses to recency over long tool chains, turns end in withheld finals

question: For this model-agnostic `message_tool_only` failure, should OpenClaw add periodic in-turn reminder reinforcement, a same-turn withheld-final recovery nudge, or both?
rationale: The fix touches model-facing runtime behavior and delivery privacy semantics; automation should not choose whether to reinsert reminders into tool results, create a recovery event after a withheld final, or combine both without maintainer intent.

options.title: Combine Stable Reminder And Recovery
options.body: Add a fixed-size reminder after bounded tool activity and a same-turn recovery marker for withheld finals, while never auto-publishing private final text.

options.title: Reminder Only
options.body: Reinforce the message-tool delivery contract during long turns but leave withheld-final recovery to later restart/heartbeat paths.

options.title: Recovery Only
options.body: Avoid extra prompt churn during tool chains and only correct when a plain final is actually withheld.

recommendation.title: Combine Stable Reminder And Recovery
recommendation.body: Add a fixed-size reminder after bounded tool activity and a same-turn recovery marker for withheld finals, while never auto-publishing private final text.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent message-tool delivery contract work in the prompt path makes this the clearest available routing owner from history.
